scope: Read-only interpretation of saved 12-row exact diagnoses and original flag files. No mesh, original dense full CSV, new intersection, parity ray, or Blender calculation was run. Distances are arithmetic conversions of stored exact event parameters only.
distance_convention: Millimetres along the recorded ray measured from its first exact source-face entry; negative start is the outward-offset origin. Each saved reduced lattice direction has squared norm one. Exact distance=(stored_t-first_entry_t)/coordinate_lattice_denominator.
original_numerical_strict_state_policy: Original numerical strict_passed=false and all 12 flags are retained; this interpretation is supplementary and not a waiver or global thickness certificate.
